name: KPI Diagnostic
summary: A number turned red. Ten statements show which cause your answers point to, clarity, skill, capacity, process design or ownership, as a hypothesis to check on the floor, with first moves.

name: 5 Whys
summary: Move from a symptom to a root cause you can change, then agree one countermeasure, one owner and one check. Print it or save it as PDF.

name: Damage Control
summary: Log damaged units by stage and cause. See the damage rate, DPMO and sigma level, the few causes behind most of it, and where to start.

name: Incomplete Control
summary: Log orders that left without every item or parcel. See the incomplete rate, DPMO and sigma level, the causes behind most misses, and where they start.

name: Delay Analyzer
summary: Log planned and actual route times. See the on-time rate, how much delay starts at the dock and how much on the road, and the reasons and hours behind it.

name: Night Audit Log
summary: Log the no-shows, declined cards, posting errors and open balances the night audit finds. See the exception rate, DPMO and sigma level, the causes behind most of them, and where in the stay they start.

name: Sigma & Control Chart
summary: Turn defects into a sigma level, combine on time, undamaged and complete into perfect delivery, and see whether a bad day is a signal or noise.

name: Pareto 80/20
summary: Which few causes make most of your delays, errors, idle time or complaints? Templates for delivery, warehouse and hotel, CSV and Excel import, a checked chart.

name: Last-Mile CX Control Tower
summary: Perfect Delivery per order, on time, incomplete, damage, cold chain, loading and departures, partner and driver scorecards, route risk, root-cause Pareto, actions and a weekly review. A deep dive on one failure: where it concentrates, the evidence rows and an investigation that becomes a verified action. Reads your Excel workbook.

name: Six Sigma in the Warehouse
summary: DMAIC in five steps on one warehouse case, with the tool to use at each step, three questions per step, the eight wastes and a project charter.

name: Shift Handover
summary: Numbers, open issues with an owner and a time, heads-up and safety in one handover. Open issues carry over to the next shift by themselves.

name: Shift Pulse
summary: Damage, incomplete orders, late routes, safety, OEE, open actions and the handover in one picture, by day or week. Trend charts, flags for what is off, and a summary to copy or print.

name: CV Builder
summary: A designer-quality CV on live A4 pages: photo, key figures, and company logos found from a website. In English, German or Albanian, saved as PDF.

name: ATS CV
summary: Drop in the CV you have, as PDF or Word. Get a clean one-column version that application software reads, matched to the job ad, as PDF, Word or text.

name: Cover Letter
summary: The letter in the same design as your CV, with your details taken from it and a first draft from a few answers. PDF or Word.

name: Action Tracker
summary: One list for every countermeasure, finding and signal from the other tools: owner, due date, status and how it is verified. Overdue first, a weekly review in ten minutes, calendar and Excel export.

name: Daily Board
summary: Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People as five month calendars of green, amber and red days, filled from your logs. Open actions, carried handover issues and a ten-minute huddle agenda to read out or print.

name: 5S Audit
summary: Walk one area and score each S from 0 to 4, in 5S, 6S or 8S, with checklists for warehouse, hotel and delivery station. A radar against the last walk, the trend and a league table by area, findings straight into actions and a red tag register.

name: Safety Cross
summary: Every accident, near miss and unsafe condition on the green cross of the month, with days since the last accident, LTIFR, TRIR and the Bird pyramid. The cause to tackle first, open actions and a talk for today's briefing.

name: A3 Report
summary: One problem on one sheet, the Toyota way: the facts and the number, the target and its date, the root cause, countermeasures with an owner each, and the follow-up. An eight-point check, print on A3 or A4, Word.

name: Kaizen Board
summary: Every improvement idea of the team on one board, from Idea through Plan, Do and Check to Adopted, with an effort and impact matrix that shows the quick wins. Adoption rate, days to adopted, savings per month and year, and the idea of the month.

name: Skills Matrix
summary: Rate each person on each task from 0 to 4 in an ILU grid, with templates for warehouse, hotel front office and delivery station. Cover against target, single points of failure, cover per shift and a training plan that pairs a level 4 with a trainee, straight into actions.

name: OEE
summary: Log each shift of a machine with its stops, pieces and rejects. Availability, performance, quality and OEE, the six big losses day by day, and the one to attack first.

name: Hotel KPIs
summary: Each night's rooms sold, revenue, no-shows, rooms out of order and complaints, pasted from the PMS. Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR against budget, the month's forecast, the weekday pattern, the revenue that leaked and a morning report to copy.

name: Fishbone
summary: Put the effect at the head and collect causes with the team on the 6M, 4P or hotel bones, each with its why. Votes and likely causes rank them, the likely ones become actions to verify, and the top one goes to 5 Whys or the causes to Pareto.

name: FMEA
summary: Write down how each process step can fail, rate severity, occurrence and detection, and get the RPN and the AIAG-VDA action priority. A heat map, the top ten risks and the actions with owners until the re-rating shows the risk is gone.

name: Process Lab
summary: Paste measurements and get the right control chart (I-MR, Xbar-R/S, np, c, u) with Nelson rules and before/after phases, Cpk, chi-square, regression and a Gage R&R or attribute agreement study. Every number in plain words.

name: Time Study
summary: Time each element over five cycles with a stopwatch, space bar as the lap key. Get the standard time per station, takt from demand, a Yamazumi against it and the first element to move.

name: Value Stream Map
summary: Map one flow from supplier to customer with the pieces waiting between the steps. Get the lead-time ladder, PCE, takt and the bottleneck, then draw the future state and send its kaizen bursts to the Action Tracker.

name: Standard Work
summary: One job as a TWI breakdown: major steps, key points marked Safety, Quality, Technique or Cost, and a reason for each, with the time per step against the takt. Versions with change notes, print on A4, Word.

name: Gemba Walk
summary: Layered process audits by team lead, area manager and site lead, with yes or no checks on the standard for warehouse, hotel and delivery station, and a waste walk that counts the 8 wastes, Mura and Muri. Compliance per week and layer, where the no answers sit, which layer is late, and findings straight into actions.

name: Operations Report
summary: The weekly or monthly report for your manager, written from the data of the other tools: safety, quality, delivery, OEE, 5S, hotel, Kaizen and actions, each against the period before and its target. What got better, what got worse, the biggest risk, one decision and three priorities. Text, A4 or Word.

name: Spaghetti Diagram
summary: Draw the walking paths of one job over the floor plan, tap by tap, in metres. Get the metres and minutes walked per shift, the stop visited most and the longest repeated leg, then compare the layout after the change.

name: Project Portfolio
summary: Every DMAIC project on one page: phase, status, the next tollgate and its checklist, days in the phase, sigma before and after, and savings planned against realised. Each project keeps its charter, SIPOC, CTQ tree, RACI, Kano, RTY, COPQ and control plan.

name: Lost & Found
summary: The register of found items from hand-in to return, police, charity or the bin, with a tag number, the safe and a photo for each. Keep-until dates, the items due for a decision, where most things are left, a reply to the guest and a tag label.

name: Room Inspection
summary: Check a cleaned room before it is released: pass, fail or n.a. by zone, critical items that fail the room on their own, a photo of the fault. Re-cleans go back to the attendant, maintenance to the Action Tracker; the first-time pass rate per attendant, floor and room type shows where to coach.

name: Maintenance Planner
summary: Plan the preventive maintenance and statutory checks of every asset by date or operating hours, log what was done, postponed or broke down, and see what is overdue, the PM compliance, MTBF and MTTR, and the work list of the week.

name: Signals
summary: Every tool in this browser read in one ranked morning list: control chart signals (p, c, u and I-MR with the run and trend rules), missed targets, overdue actions, maintenance, red tags and ideas, and safety on top.

name: Room Status
summary: The live room board of the shift: every room by floor with its housekeeping code (VD, VC, VI, OCC, OD, DO, CO, OOO, OOS), DND, VIP and arrival flags and its attendant. It shows the next room to clean, the rooms ready for today's arrivals, the out-of-order share and the minutes from check-out to clean and from clean to inspected.

name: Guest Complaints
summary: The complaint and service-recovery log of the front office: LEARN, the action, the compensation in euros, the time to resolve and the call back. Complaints per 100 occupied room nights, the share resolved within target, repeat rooms, the Pareto of the categories and a reply to the guest.

name: Housekeeping Planner
summary: The executive housekeeper's staffing plan: departures, stay-overs, linen changes, VIP rooms, deep cleans and public areas become workload minutes (or credits) and the attendants needed against those scheduled, with hours, labour cost and minutes per occupied room. Sections balanced by minutes on as few floors as possible, printed per attendant or set into Room Status, and the week from the forecast.

name: Leader Standard Work
summary: Each leader's routine as a standard, from the team leader's huddle to the site manager's Gemba walk, checked off every day: done, or missed with a reason. The next level up reviews the adherence each week, sees the share of the day in standard work against the guide for the level, and sends a task missed three times in two weeks to the Action Tracker.

name: Shift Capacity
summary: Turn the volume forecast and the rate of each process into the heads every shift needs, with breaks, utilisation and absence, and see the gap against the planned team, the bottleneck and how to close it with overtime, agency or qualified people from another process.

name: ABC/XYZ Inventory
summary: Classify every SKU by annual consumption value and by how steady its demand is, and get the nine-cell matrix with its policies, the cycle counts per week, safety stock and reorder points at your service level, and the SKUs for the golden zone.

name: SMED Changeover
summary: Time one changeover element by element, split it into internal and external work, convert and streamline by Shingo's steps, and see the minutes and euros freed and the new changeover standard.

name: 8D Report
summary: The Global 8D for a problem a customer saw, D0 to D8: containment within a day, 5W2H and IS / IS NOT, the root cause and the escape point both verified, corrective actions validated with data. Days open and to containment against targets, every action to the tracker, print and Word.

name: Risk Assessment
summary: The documented risk assessment of each work area: hazards from the eleven hazard-factor groups, likelihood × severity on a 5 × 5 matrix, measures in the STOP order with owners and their effectiveness check, the residual risk and the review date, set against the events of the Safety Cross.

name: Hoshin Kanri
summary: The site's strategy on one X-matrix: breakthrough and annual objectives, improvement priorities, metrics and their owners, with the gaps listed. Catchball notes per priority, a bowling chart month by month, and a countermeasure when a metric misses twice in a row.

name: Print Pack
summary: The paper of the team board in one print, from what the tools hold in this browser: open actions by owner, the week's maintenance work list and 5S audits, a card per leader, the Safety Cross and Daily Board of the month, and the attendant and section sheets of a hotel.

name: Site Compare
summary: The sites you look after side by side, each read from its read-only team code without joining: damage and incomplete rates, routes on time, OEE, 5S, safety, actions, maintenance and the hotel rates, best and worst named, ranked by a rule you can see.

name: Kaizen Event
summary: Plan, run and follow up a rapid improvement event: the charter with goals in numbers, preparation counted back from the first day, the standard 3–5 day agenda, ideas by waste on an effort and impact matrix, goals before and after, and the 30-day follow-up list. Report-out in A4 and Word.

name: Cost of Quality
summary: List what prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure cost, as hours, counts or amounts for any period, and get the cost of quality a month and a year, the cost of poor quality as a share of revenue, the largest items and what a cut in failure would save.
cta: Put a number on poor quality

name: Waste Log
summary: Weigh and log food waste, expired and damaged goods, scrap and linen with the reason and where it went. Kg and euro lost per day, grams per cover, the Pareto of categories and reasons, and the weeks against a reduction target.

name: Heijunka
summary: Turn a batched schedule into a levelled mix: takt, pitch, load and EPEI, the day's heijunka box with clock times, and the changeovers it costs against the finished stock it saves.

name: Kanban Sizing
summary: Work out how many kanban cards each supermarket or two-bin loop needs, by Toyota's formula or a statistical safety stock, see the cards to add or take out and the stock value at maximum, and print the cards eight to an A4 sheet.

name: Andon Log
summary: Log every call for help on the floor, live with a running clock or after the fact. Time to respond and to solve against your targets, who to call now for an open call, the Pareto of reasons and stopped minutes, and the hours when calls pile up.

name: Poka-Yoke Register
summary: Every mistake-proofing device in one register: the error it prevents, Shingo's method, control or warning, prevention or detection. Test each on schedule with a deliberate error; see what is overdue or failed, verification compliance, effectiveness per device and a checklist to print.

name: Energy & Water
summary: Meter readings for electricity, gas, water, district heat or oil turned into use, cost and CO₂ for any period, kWh per occupied room night or per order, each meter against its own baseline, and a signal when a week drifts above it.

name: Lean Assessment
summary: Score how mature an area's lean system is in ten dimensions, from 5S to kaizen, with up to five assessors: the spread shows where they disagree, the radar the change since last quarter, and the three weakest dimensions link to the tools that close them.
